_note: followup-implementation-progress (fol-10, mot-13): dated implementation updates on adopted decisions, the current status on the decision, and a 90-day silence reminder to the secretariat. Numbered 130, not the 92 the change names: 92 was taken.

x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

ImplementationUpdate.title: Implementation update
ImplementationUpdate.description: A dated report on how far the implementation of an adopted decision or motion has got: a status, an optional percentage and what happened. A record, not a draft: once added only an administrator changes or removes it.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: The adopted decision or motion this update reports on. Only a decision that is decided or enacted with outcome adopted takes updates (REQ-FUP-001).

reportedOn.title: Reported on
reportedOn.description: The date the progress is reported for. The newest update by this date sets the decision's implementation status (REQ-FUP-002).

status.title: Status
status.description: How the implementation stands on that date.

percentComplete.title: Percent complete
percentComplete.description: How much of the implementation is done, when that can be said.

text.title: What happened
text.description: What happened since the previous update.

reportedBy.title: Reported by
reportedBy.description: The Nextcloud account that added the update; set by the server.

implementationStatus.title: Implementation status
implementationStatus.description: The status of the newest implementation update by date; set by the server, never in a form (REQ-FUP-002).

implementationStatusDate.title: Implementation status date
implementationStatusDate.description: The date of the newest implementation update; set by the server.

implementationSilent._note: REQ-FUP-004. Daily sweep over adopted decisions not completed or abandoned whose newest update, or decision date when there is none, is more than 90 days old.
